text:
rachel (People Ops): hi @sam.perez  quick heads-up before Day 1 next Thurs — a couple of edge cases on your onboarding: name change on passport, county fingerprinting requested by the background vendor, and laptop shipping. can you confirm availability for a kiosk slot if needed?

sam.perez: hey team — thanks. passport has my new married name but my offer uses my old surname. also vendor emailed asking for "in-person fingerprinting" at a county office. i'm remote until Friday.

jen (Benefits): re: name mismatch, payroll needs ID that matches SSN card or passport. if names differ, upload a signed Name Affidavit form and a marriage certificate. we can then reconcile for payroll. i'll send the affidavit link.

rachel (People Ops): fingerprinting is unusual but vendor sometimes requests it for certain counties. we can either: 1) schedule the vendor at a local authorized site (they have partners in many counties) or 2) if you can come to SF within 5 days we can do it via our partner. which do you prefer?

sam.perez: prefer local partner. i'm in Portland. can you check partner availability? also laptop tracking says "delivery delayed - address not verified".

it-ship-bot: Shipping alert PKG-33412: status = address verification required. Please confirm shipping address on file: 78 Alder St, Apt 4, Portland, OR 97201. Reply CONFIRM or UPDATE <new address>.

sam.perez: CONFIRM.

it-ship-bot: Address confirmed. Courier ETA updated to next business day. If delivery misses Day 1, reply LOANER to reserve a temporary machine at the Portland partner site.

fingerprint-vendor-bot: Fingerprint vendor notice: partner site found near Portland (Portland Fingerprint Center). Available slots: Tue 09:00, Wed 14:30. To book, reply BOOK <slot>. Required: government ID + appointment confirmation email.

sam.perez: BOOK Wed 14:30 please.

rachel (People Ops): booked fingerprint slot Wed 14:30. Jen, once Sam uploads affidavit & marriage cert, can payroll proceed?

jen (Benefits): yes. Sam, i'll DM the Name Affidavit and confirm what supporting docs we need. once uploaded we'll mark payroll reconciliation pending and it won't block Day 1.

sam.perez: uploaded marriage cert + signed affidavit. also booked fingerprint. thanks. Tom, do you want to meet Day 1?

tom (Onboarding Buddy): yes! i'll send a 20-min intro at 10:30 PT and a short walkthrough of benefits sign-up. see you then. :wave:

rachel (People Ops): summary: fingerprint appointment Wed 14:30 Portland, address confirmed for laptop, name affidavit uploaded. we'll mark I-9 plan as "remote Section 1 + local fingerprint verification" and payroll flagged for name reconcile. welcome aboard! :tada:
